name: Disable Windows Game Mode
desc: Disables Windows Game Mode and Game DVR to improve gaming performance and reduce background activity.

name: Disable GameDVR
desc: Disables GameDVR to improve gaming performance and reduce background resource usage.

name: Disable Animations for Performance
desc: Disables unnecessary Windows animations and visual effects to improve performance.

name: Disable Windows Update
desc: Disables Windows Update and related services to prevent automatic updates.

name: Disable Search Indexing
desc: Disables Windows Search indexing to improve performance by reducing background resource usage.

name: Disable Fast Startup
desc: Disables Windows Fast Startup to improve system reliability and reduce potential driver conflicts.

name: Debloat Windows
desc: Remove unnecessary applications and files to free up system resources.
note: Cannot revert Windows Debloating. Reinstallation required.

apply.a: /F "C:\Program Files\WindowsApps" /R /A && icacls "C:\Program Files\WindowsApps" /grant administrators:F && takeown /F "C:\ProgramData\Packages" /R /A && icacls "C:\ProgramData\Packages" /grant administrators:F && takeown /F "C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps" /R /A && icacls "C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps" /grant administrators:F && takeown /F "C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Packages" /R /A && icacls "C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Packages" /grant administrators:F && takeown /F "C:\Windows\SystemApps" /R /A && icacls "C:\Windows\SystemApps" /grant administrators:F && rmdir /s /q "C:\Program Files\WindowsApps" && rmdir /s /q "C:\ProgramData\Packages" && rmdir /s /q "C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps" && rmdir /s /q "C:\Users\*\AppData\Local\Packages" && rmdir /s /q "C:\Windows\SystemApps" && del /f /q "C:\Windows\System32\smartscreen.exe" && del /f /q "C:\Windows\System32\mobsync.exe" && powershell.exe -Command "Get-AppxPackage -allusers *3DBuilder* | Remove-AppxPackage; name: Disable Background Apps
desc: Prevents background applications from running to reduce unnecessary network and resource usage.

name: Disable Remote Assistance
desc: Disables remote assistance features to enhance system security.

name: Disable Scheduled Tasks
desc: Disables unnecessary scheduled tasks to improve performance and reduce unnecessary system processes.

name: Disable Driver Searching for Windows Update
desc: Prevents Windows Update from automatically searching for device drivers.

name: Disable Hibernation
desc: Disables the hibernation feature to free up storage space and reduce system resource usage.

name: Disable Settings Sync
desc: Disables synchronization of settings across Microsoft accounts for improved privacy and reduced bandwidth usage.

name: Remove NVIDIA Telemetry
desc: Disables NVIDIA telemetry services and tasks to improve privacy and performance.
note: Reinstallation of NVIDIA drivers is required to revert telemetry-related changes.

name: Disable Tiled Display
desc: Disables tiled display functionality for NVIDIA cards.

name: Disable HDCP
desc: Disables HDCP functionality to enhance compatibility and reduce potential overhead on NVIDIA cards.
note: Revert not supported automatically. Reinstalling drivers may reset HDCP settings.

name: Force P0-State
desc: Forces the NVIDIA GPU to stay in the highest performance state (P0) for better performance.

name: No ECC
desc: Disables error correction code (ECC) for NVIDIA GPUs to improve performance.

name: Unrestricted Clock Policy
desc: Removes clock restrictions to maximize GPU performance.

name: Disable Preemption
desc: Disables GPU preemption to improve stability for certain workloads.

name: AMD Optimized Settings
desc: Applies general AMD registry optimizations for improved performance and reduced resource usage.

name: AMD DVR Settings
desc: Optimizes AMD DVR settings for performance and user customization.

name: AMD Overlay and Notification Settings
desc: Disables unnecessary AMD overlay notifications and visual effects to optimize performance.

name: AMD Scene Settings
desc: Optimizes AMD Scene configurations for better performance and improved visual effects.

name: Debloat AMD Drivers
desc: Removes unnecessary files and directories from AMD drivers to free up disk space and optimize performance.
note: Reinstallation of the AMD driver software will be required to revert changes.

name: Configure TimerResolution
desc: Optimizes TimerResolution to minimize processor sleep intervals, enabling faster handling of interrupts and improved system responsiveness.

name: Disable Idle
desc: Disables processor idle states to maintain consistent performance.

name: Set CSRSS to High Priority
desc: Adjusts the priority of the Client/Server Runtime Subsystem (CSRSS) for improved system performance.

name: Low Audio Latency
desc: Downloads and sets up a tool to reduce audio latency on startup.

name: Set Process Priority Separation
desc: Configures process priority separation for optimal multitasking performance.

name: Disable Auto-detection of Proxy
desc: Disables auto-detection of proxy for performance optimization.

name: Disable Activity History
desc: Prevents Windows from storing and uploading user activity history.

name: Disable Telemetry Tasks and Settings
desc: Disables various telemetry-related tasks and settings to enhance privacy.

name: Windows Defender
desc: Turn off Windows Defender and related features to reduce system overhead.

name: Windows Firewall
desc: Disables Windows Firewall for Public and Standard profiles.

name: Disable Notifications
desc: Disables system-wide notifications to reduce interruptions.

name: Change Boot Menu Policy
desc: Sets the boot menu policy to legacy for advanced boot options.

name: Remove Managed by Organization Settings in Edge
desc: Removes any custom organization-managed settings in Microsoft Edge.

name: Disable Security Notifications
desc: Disables persistent and disruptive security notifications.

name: Always Show All Icons on the Taskbar
desc: Shows all icons on the taskbar without hiding them in the tray.

name: Old Photo Viewer
desc: Enables the old Windows Photo Viewer for image file associations.

name: Sticky Keys
desc: Configures Sticky Keys to customized values for accessibility.

name: Show Task View
desc: Hides the Task View button from the taskbar.

name: Show Chat in Taskbar
desc: Disables the Chat icon in the taskbar.

name: Disable Notification Tasks
desc: Disables scheduled tasks related to system notifications.

name: Disable Transparency Effects
desc: Disables transparency effects in themes.

name: Disable Automatic Maintenance
desc: Disables Windows automatic maintenance.

name: Disable Advertising ID
desc: Disables the Advertising ID system for Windows.

name: Disable Telemetry Data Collection
desc: Disables telemetry data collection by Windows to improve privacy and reduce unnecessary background activity.

name: Disable Geolocation Services
desc: Prevents apps and services from accessing geolocation data.

name: Disable Application Experience Telemetry
desc: Prevents Windows from collecting telemetry data related to application compatibility and usage.

name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
desc: Disables Windows Error Reporting to stop the system from sending error data to Microsoft.

name: Disable Telemetry and Data Collection
desc: Prevents Windows from collecting telemetry and diagnostic data for enhanced privacy.

name: Disable Feedback Notifications
desc: Turns off Windows feedback notifications and related telemetry for enhanced privacy.

name: Delete Unused Data and Caches
desc: Removes unnecessary application data and caches to free up space and enhance privacy.
note: Recreation of deleted data is not supported.

name: Clear Registry Recent Entries
desc: Deletes various recent registry entries related to system usage for privacy.
note: Recreation of deleted registry entries is not supported.

name: Clear Google Chrome Data
desc: Removes Google Chrome user data, crash reports, and logs to enhance privacy and free up disk space.
note: Google Chrome data cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Clear Windows Explorer and Temp Files
desc: Deletes database files, temporary files, and cached data to improve system performance and reclaim storage.
note: Temporary files cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Clear Windows Defender Scan History
desc: Removes scan history logs from Windows Defender to improve privacy.
note: Windows Defender scan history cannot be restored.

name: Clear CBS and DISM Logs
desc: Deletes CBS and DISM logs to free up disk space and maintain privacy.
note: CBS and DISM logs cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Run Disk Cleanup
desc: Executes the built-in Windows Disk Cleanup utility to free up disk space.
note: Disk cleanup results cannot be reverted.

name: Remove Java Cache
desc: Deletes Java deployment cache to free up disk space and enhance privacy.
note: Java cache cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Clear Flash Player Data
desc: Removes Flash Player data to ensure privacy and reclaim disk space.
note: Flash Player data cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Delete Steam Crash Dumps and Traces
desc: Removes Steam crash dumps, traces, and log files to free up space and enhance privacy.
note: Steam logs and dumps cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Clear Temporary Internet Files
desc: Removes temporary internet files to improve privacy and free up storage space.
note: Temporary Internet Files cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Clear LocalService Temp Files
desc: Deletes temporary files under the LocalService profile to free up space.
note: Temporary files under LocalService cannot be restored.

name: Clear CBS and DISM Logs
desc: Deletes CBS and DISM logs to clean up disk space and remove old diagnostic data.
note: CBS and DISM logs cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Clear NetSetup, Setupcln, and Temp Files
desc: Cleans up NetSetup logs, setupcln logs, and temporary files to improve system hygiene.
note: NetSetup, setupcln, and temporary files cannot be restored after deletion.

name: Clear Disk with CleanMgr
desc: Runs CleanMgr with Sagerun to clear disk space.
note: Disk cleanup via CleanMgr cannot be reverted.

name: Disable Security Scheduled Tasks
desc: Disable Security Scheduled Tasks in exchange for higher privacy.

name: Notification and User Experience Tweaks
desc: Suppresses unnecessary notifications and modifies UI elements to improve focus and usability.

name: Disable Visual Studio Telemetry
desc: Disables telemetry collection in Visual Studio by modifying registry keys.

name: Disable Visual Studio Feedback
desc: Disables Visual Studio feedback prompts and inputs by modifying related registry keys.

name: Disable Windows Media Player Telemetry
desc: Disables usage tracking and metadata retrieval in Windows Media Player by modifying registry keys and disabling related services.

name: Disable Google Update Services
desc: Disables Google Update services and tasks to prevent automatic updates.

name: Disable Scheduled Adobe Update Tasks
desc: Disables scheduled tasks related to Adobe updates to reduce system resource usage.

name: Disable Adobe Flash Player Update Service
desc: Disables the Adobe Flash Player Update Service to prevent unnecessary updates and save resources.

apply.a: -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Command "$serviceName = 'adobeflashplayerupdatesvc'; if((Get-Service -Name $serviceName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Stop-Service -Name $serviceName -Force; Set-Service -Name $serviceName -StartupType Disabled; }"

revert.a: -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Command "$serviceName = 'adobeflashplayerupdatesvc'; if((Get-Service -Name $serviceName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Set-Service -Name $serviceName -StartupType Manual; Start-Service -Name $serviceName; }"

name: Configure SCHANNEL Registry Settings
desc: Configures SCHANNEL settings to use a minimum key length of 1024 bits for Diffie-Hellman key exchange algorithms.

name: Disable NULL Cipher
desc: Disables NULL cipher to prevent unencrypted communications.
